# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.x     | ✅        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you find a security issue in Ashenreach, please report it privately:

- Open a [security advisory](https://github.com/jordan-thirkle/ashenreach/security/advisories/new) on this repository.
- Do not post exploit details in public issues.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 72 hours and provide a remediation timeline.

## Supply Chain

- All 3D models, textures, and audio are generated in-repository or sourced from Apache-2.0 assets (Khronos glTF-Sample-Assets). There are no third-party binary dependencies with unknown provenance.
- Dependabot keeps npm and GitHub Actions dependencies current.
- CodeQL runs on every push and pull request.
